name: Kickin' It
s: Kickin' It is American comedy television series, which debuted on June 13, 2011 and concluded on March 25, 2015 on Disney XD. The series stars former Hannah Montana star Jason Earles, Leo Howard from Leo Little's Big Show and Moises Arias' brother: Mateo Arias. paragraphs.text: Kickin' It is an American comedy television series created by Jim O'Doherty that aired on Disney XD from June 13, 2011 to March 25, 2015. The series stars Leo Howard, Dylan Riley Snyder, Mateo Arias, Olivia Holt, Alex Christian Jones, and Jason Earles.

Located in a strip mall, the Bobby Wasabi Martial Arts Academy is known as the worst dojo in the underperforming nationwide Bobby Wasabi chain. To improve the dojo's image, a tight knit crew of underdogs enlists Jack to join and help teach them about life, karate, and friendship.
